tools.name: ograf_get_capabilities
tools.title: Get OGraf authoring capabilities
tools.description: Discover section contracts and editor readiness. view=sessions: List session revisions.

tools.name: ograf_get_project
tools.title: Get editable OGraf project
tools.description: Read project/revision; include/tracks filter output. view=changes: Read up to 100 changes after sinceRevision. view=timeline: Read layer tracks/lifecycle/loops. Easing applies to the incoming segment.

tools.name: ograf_inspect_scene
tools.title: Inspect OGraf scene
tools.description: Inspect scene links/motion/warnings/revision. mode=query: Query layer semantics/names/bindings/motion.

tools.name: ograf_sample_tracks
tools.title: Sample resolved OGraf layer geometry
tools.description: Sample geometry/lights/patterns; loopElapsedFrame is absolute on-air time. No browser.

tools.name: ograf_capture
tools.title: Capture browser-rendered OGraf PNG
tools.description: PNG; first Step default. Matte/dataOverrides: composition only. reference: workspace PNG/JPEG/WebP to compare with; returns difference scores and a difference picture. URL 5 min; base64 opt-in. Not certification. mode=strip: Browser strip: max12 frames, lifecycle/midpoints default; maxDimension/tile. URL 5 min; base64 opt-in. mode=svg: Render a deterministic SVG without mutation.

tools.name: ograf_apply_operations
tools.title: Apply OGraf operations
tools.description: Atomic apply, dry-run, preview, or Accept/Reject proposal. When building in a blank template with no saved prompt, include set_project_metadata.authoringPrompt with the original user request in the first layer or recipe batch.

authoringPrompt.description: Actual user prompt intended for inclusion in the template and export.

13.description: Every layer whose name matches; * is any run of characters.

enabled.description: add_effect: false unless blendMode is set

direction.description: Text uses auto, ltr or rtl. Ticker travel uses left or right.

tools.name: ograf_validate_project
tools.title: Validate editable OGraf project
tools.description: Advisory semantic/field/text/broadcast checks; not certification. check=design: Advisory QA with IDs; includeStrip adds frames. Not certification. check=text: Browser text fit/overflow/clipping at frame.

tools.name: ograf_create_project
tools.title: Create OGraf project session
tools.description: Create a memory session with the original user prompt saved in the template. Pass the user’s request verbatim from your conversation. The editor session belongs to the browser. mode=reset: Replace the session with a fresh template and save the supplied original user prompt verbatim. Requires confirmation and the current revision. keepDataFields retains main fields.

originalPrompt.description: Verbatim user request for this template, from the MCP client conversation.

tools.name: ograf_delete_session
tools.title: Delete temporary OGraf authoring session
tools.description: Delete a non-editor session with confirm; saved files remain.

tools.name: ograf_open_project
tools.title: Open OGraf editable project
tools.description: Open workspace JSON .ogs/.ogeproj in a new session. ZIP .ogs/.ogp: open in Studio and activate a template.

tools.name: ograf_import_asset
tools.title: Import a workspace asset into OGraf
tools.description: Embed workspace image/video/audio/font/text (32 MiB max); returns asset:<id>. mode=svg-bundle: Embed workspace SVG/CSS/images/fonts atomically: 32 MiB/file, 64 MiB total.

tools.name: ograf_undo
tools.title: Undo agent change
tools.description: Undo the latest agent transaction. direction=redo: Redo the latest agent transaction.

tools.name: ograf_certify_project
tools.title: Certify OGraf output
tools.description: Certify project/manifest/package/module/lifecycle in the editor.

tools.name: ograf_save_project
tools.title: Save OGraf project and PNG
tools.description: Certify/save .ogs + thumbnail. scope=set: Save a revision-checked whole-set .ogs snapshot copy. Compact stores shared payloads once; compatible writes schema 5 for older set readers. Workspace paths only, up to 64 MiB compressed. Does not certify playout or rename the open document.

tools.name: ograf_export_package
tools.title: Export certified OGraf or standalone HTML
tools.description: Export a certified .ograf.zip with thumbnail or a self-contained .html preview. The path extension selects the output. scope=set: Export frozen graph/artwork with a PNG thumbnail. Select a .ograf.zip package or self-contained .html preview by path extension. Lane-dependent selects have defaults and the runtime checks the current on-air template. Rejects stale revisions, unapplied drafts and source changes. Explicit workspace path; no picker. Reuse operationId with identical arguments to recover uncertain results or retry the same certified bytes. IDs live for this server process (32 operations); success rechecks output hash. Reports included states/templates and unreferenced templates.

tools.name: ograf_export_video
tools.title: Export a WebM video
tools.description: Render one template as a WebM movie in the connected editor and save it in the workspace: Start to End, waiting holdSeconds on each Step, transparent unless transparent:false. At most 64 MiB; lower bitrate, maxDimension or holdSeconds for a longer movie. A call with the same operationId waits for a running export or answers again for a saved one.

tools.name: ograf_get_template_set
tools.title: Inspect the open template set
tools.description: Read set/revision/defaults; projects and selected resourceUsage opt-in. Filter templateIds or page offset/limit.

tools.name: ograf_update_template_set
tools.title: Manage templates and shared set defaults
tools.description: Apply set command using get_template_set revision. For new_template, duplicate_template, or paste_template, pass the exact user request in originalPrompt. Confirm removal/replacement; file pickers use UI.

definition.description: Definition/null. v6 slot updateMode; v5 recipe incomingAnimation/outgoingAnimation (template/builtin/plugin), pinned animationPresetPlugins; reads v1-4. Nonshared content moves; shared objects morph. Admission guards/defaults/precedence kept. parentSlotId cascades Out/Clear; takeOutSlotIds awaits targets/dependents Out, no restore.

originalPrompt.description: Verbatim user request for this template, from the MCP client conversation.

tools.name: ograf_review_template_transfer
tools.title: Review template branding transfer
tools.description: Review branding and settings, or list members of a workspace set. Select source.templateId when requested. Returns bounded rows and a frozen plan ID. Files up to 64 MiB. step=preview: Render before and after images for the exact reviewed plan. Returns expiring image URLs. Recheck a file with the same workspaceFile path and member.

originalPrompt.description: Verbatim user request for this template, from the MCP client conversation.

tools.name: ograf_commit_template_transfer
tools.title: Apply a reviewed template transfer
tools.description: Apply one undoable transfer from a reviewed plan and exact revisions. Requires confirm:true. Supply the same workspaceFile path and member for file sources.

tools.name: ograf_get_playout
tools.title: Inspect Studio live playout
tools.description: Read playout revision, states, lane readiness/current/pending/errors and tickerUpdates. target:preview reads the visible combined Preview & Export session; omitted/live reads the separate live/MCP session.

tools.name: ograf_control_playout
tools.title: Control Studio live playout
tools.description: Use matching-target revision + unique requestId; poll completion and retry uncertain results with the same requestId. Update mode:in-place patches on-air data without a lane transition; omitted/transition mode keeps authored update transitions. target:preview accepts Update only for graphics already taken in Studio controls. Omitted/live target: Take uses prepared state when stateId omitted; Update guards active state; parent Out/Clear cascades without restore; template-action runs on-air actions including clocks.

tools.name: ograf_read_result_page
tools.title: Read a retained tool result
tools.description: Read complete JSON pages by resultId/path/offset, or page a read-only sourceTool/input. Never reruns a mutation.
